announcements.headline: Results of AGM, Board Changes
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of the Annual General Meeting and indicates a change in the board composition. Such updates are standard governance events that inform shareholders about leadership structure without implying immediate financial or strategic shifts.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director or person discharging managerial responsibilities has dealt in the company's shares, which is a routine disclosure of personal trading activity. It provides limited insight into the company's operational performance but may signal individual confidence or lack thereof depending on the nature of the deal.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report and Notice of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results and the convening of a general meeting for shareholder consideration. It provides standard periodic updates on performance and governance matters without indicating specific directional outcomes or material changes.

announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a change in the board composition, which is a standard governance update. While such changes can signal strategic shifts or succession planning, the headline alone does not provide details on the nature or significance of the appointment.
